name: Earthshape — counters put on the land after the spell is added do not raise the bound
notes: (2026-10-18) The bound is the land's power in the spell's snapshot, as the spell leaves it: with no counters on the Forest when Earthshape was added it is a 0/0, so only power 0 or less qualifies, the Forest itself and Ornithopter, even though three counters put on afterwards make the Forest 3/3 on the board. Grizzly Bears does not qualify.
